item.title: People along the Gulf Coast prepare for Hurricane Isaias
item.description: Isaias became the first hurricane of the Atlantic season late Wednesday. It's expected to make landfall along the U.S. Gulf Coast Friday.

item.title: Teen arrested for alleged shooting plot at the Mall of America, authorities say
item.description: Federal prosecutors say a teenager is under arrest, under suspicion of plotting a mass shooting at Minnesota's Mall of America.
